evals.prompt: Refresh this project's README hero and circular project-page thumbnail. The repository already has a mascot in assets/mascot.png, and I want the hero to stay useful without updating it every release.
assertions: The agent inspects existing repository artwork and treats assets/mascot.png as the identity source instead of inventing a replacement mascot
The hero plan uses a spacious 3:1 layout and omits version numbers, item counts, and other facts that become stale
The circular thumbnail is derived from a high-resolution square mascot master rather than cropped from the wide hero
The agent plans to inspect both the full-size outputs and the actual thumbnail display size

evals.prompt: My new developer tool has no visual identity yet. Create a mascot for it, let me choose, and then make a matching hero and social image.
assertions: The agent learns the tool's real mechanism from the repository before selecting metaphors
The agent creates three meaningfully different high-resolution mascot concepts rather than three color swaps
The agent waits for the user's mascot selection before generating the dependent hero and social card
All concepts preserve a circular safe area and are reviewed at 64px
The selected image becomes the canonical reference for later assets

evals.prompt: I like this mascot and composition. The white texture is too strong and should only appear subtly on the left side. Fix that and keep everything else.
assertions: The agent edits the selected image instead of replacing it with a new composition
The repair request explicitly preserves pose, anatomy, palette, props, crop, and typography while changing only texture placement and intensity
The repaired image is opened and visually inspected before it replaces the integrated asset
The earlier approved version remains available
